name: Button
summary: An action or navigation link with an ink outline or fill that turns marker blue on hover, with registration corner marks on hover and focus.
whenToUse: To trigger an action on the page, such as copying an email address.
To link to a key destination styled as an action, such as the resume or the work section.
whenNotToUse: Inside another link or button. Make the outer element the only interactive one.
For inline links within body text. Use a plain text link.
More than one primary button in the same view.

variants.name: outline
variants.description: Default. Transparent fill, ink outline and ink label.

variants.name: primary
variants.description: Ink fill with a paper label. For the single most important action in a view.

states.name: hover
states.visual: Marker fill and outline, paper label, corner marks appear.

states.name: focus-visible
states.visual: 2px marker outline offset 3px, corner marks appear. Fill unchanged.

states.name: disabled
states.trigger: disabled attribute on a button (links cannot be disabled).
states.visual: 45% opacity, no hover change, not-allowed cursor.

anatomy.description: The outlined or filled shape; the hit area is at least 44px tall.
The visible text, which is also the accessible name.
Optional decorative icon after the label, such as an arrow.
Two registration marks at opposite corners, shown on hover and focus.

tokens.name: color.paper
tokens.usedFor: label on primary and on hover

tokens.name: color.marker
tokens.usedFor: hover fill and outline, focus ring

constants.name: line-height
constants.reason: Inherited from body in the source; no line-height token exists yet.

constants.name: focus ring
constants.reason: Global :focus-visible rule in the source; candidate for a focus token later.

notes: The label is the accessible name; the icon is hidden from assistive technology.
Minimum height 44px meets the touch target guideline.
Source issue: Work.tsx:70 draws a button as a <span> inside a card link. The component does not support that; make the card the link instead.
Colour contrast is not checked in unit tests (jsdom cannot render). It is checked in the Storybook accessibility panel.

do: Start the label with a verb: "Explore my work", "Copy email".
Use one primary button per view and outline for the rest.
Use href for navigation so it is a real link.
dont: Don't nest a button in a link or another button.
Don't use an icon without a label.
Don't disable a button without telling people why nearby.

responsive: Horizontal padding follows space.4: 28px below 600px, 32px from 600px.
Label size follows font.size.body: fluid from 16px to 18px.
Source note: the hero overrides the primary button to 14px text and 8px padding below 600px (src/components/Hero.css:856). That is a page-level override, not a variant.
openQuestions: Approve the proposed disabled state, or leave disabled unstyled like the source?
Should the 1.5px outline stay 1.5px? Chromium draws it as 1px on standard screens, so the site looks thinner than the token.
